newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia's Sime Bank unit raises US$125 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Sime Bank unit raises US$125 mln FRCD.

text.p: SIME International Bank 's floating rate certificate of deposit issue was increased to US$125 million from US$100 million, arrangers said Friday.
The deal is guaranteed by SIME Bank BHD.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with no put or call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 23.5 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 27 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers with US$8 million each are Development Bank of Singapore, Fuji International Finance and LTCB Asia.

Co-arrangers and lead managers with US$8 million each are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Singapore, Banque Nationale de Paris, Singapore, Daiwa Overseas Finance, DKB Asia, Dresdner SEA, Tokai Asia, and Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong.
Co-lead manager Royal Bank of Scotland committed US$7 million, while Girocredit Bank committed US$6 million.
Other co-lead managers with US$5 million each are Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena Singapore, Bank of East Asia Singapore, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz, Morgan Stanley Asia and Yasuda Trust and Banking.
Senior manager SBI European Bank committed US$3 million. Other senior managers with US$2 million each are GZB-Bank Genossenschaftliche Zentralbank Stuttgart and National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
